questions.stemHtml: A 46-year-old diabetic patient presented with fever, malaise, and a productive cough. His chest X-ray is given below. Which of the following statements is incorrect? {{caption_text}}

options.label: A
options.text: Patchy infiltrates as seen in pyogenic pneumonia

options.label: B
options.text: Interstitial infiltrates as seen in Mycoplasma pneumonia

options.label: C
options.text: Hilar lymphadenopathy with infiltrates as seen in malignancy

options.label: D
options.text: Aspiration pneumonia is more common in the upper segment of the lower lobe and posterior segment of the upper lobe
